verdict.rationale: Virtual Mail (formerly Earth Class Mail) publishes a documented public REST API. It has a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, a versioned base URL and API-key auth that reaches every mailbox the user can access, and the vendor says APIs keep "documents and mail" in sync with other tools. However, the pack never quotes specific endpoints for listing mail items or downloading scan images or PDFs. The related MCP server only shows natural-language finding and reading of mail. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of list-mail-items and scan-download endpoints, sandbox or test mode, a changelog or deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list mail items and download scans through a documented public API — my systems ingest postal mail like any other data source

citations.quote: The OpenAPI 3.1 specification is available as a YAML file for import into tools like Postman, Swagger UI, or code generators.
Your API key is tied to your user account, so it can reach every mailbox you have access to.
Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
